record.what_it_does: NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook) is Google's AI research tool that grounds chat, summaries, audio/video overviews, and reports in documents a user uploads or links into a notebook.
record.auth_notes: The public API only exists for 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise' (the Cloud/enterprise edition), not the consumer notebooklm.google.com product. Calls go through the Discovery Engine API using standard Google Cloud credentials: examples use `gcloud auth print-access-token` (OAuth2 user token), and the RPC reference lists required OAuth scopes (`cloud-platform`, `discoveryengine.readwrite`, `discoveryengine.serving.readwrite`) that also work with service-account (JWT) credentials for server-to-server use.
record.access_notes: Enterprise setup only: create a GCP project with billing, enable the Discovery Engine API, configure an identity provider (Cloud Identity or third-party IdP via Workforce Identity Federation), and assign 'Cloud NotebookLM' IAM roles/licenses. A 14-day free-trial subscription (5000 licenses) is self-serve via the Cloud console; ongoing use requires a paid monthly/yearly subscription with a minimum of 15 licenses. No free path exists for the consumer NotebookLM product, which has no public API at all.
record.main_blocker: API only exists for the paid Gemini Notebook Enterprise product, gated behind GCP project/billing setup, enterprise IdP configuration, and per-seat licensing (min 15 seats) after a 14-day trial
